slot_scores.name: minimum_profit_target
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum profit requirement or a $10,000 lower bound on weekly profit. The broad request for other constraints did not clearly target this hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: min_production_model_B
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other constraints or requirements for the weekly production plan, such as a minimum production quantity for Model B, a maximum total number of units, or any relationship between the two models?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about a minimum production quantity for Model B, which the user then confirmed as at least 15 units per week.

slot_scores.name: exact_process_I_time
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 150-hour maximum weekly capacity for Process I a hard ceiling that cannot be exceeded, or is it also a regular-time limit that can be exceeded through overtime?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the nature of the Process I capacity, but did not ask whether Process I time must be exactly 150 hours rather than merely at most 150.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum weekly profit requirement or $10,000 lower bound; the model only maximizes total profit without an additional profit target.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the minimum profit target, and the final model/summary omitted any such lower bound.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Process I time is limited to at most 150 hours, not required to equal exactly 150 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked whether the 150-hour limit was a hard ceiling, but did not ask or confirm the exact-equality requirement for Process I time.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All hidden slots are P2 severity. The agent resolved H2 and partially addressed H3, while missing H1; no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained when it entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The interaction covered the Model B minimum well and touched the Process I capacity issue, but it missed the minimum profit target and never clarified whether Process I time must be exactly 150 hours. Since all missed issues were P2-level, the stop was not premature under the severity rules.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
